Certainly! Here’s a draft of a concise professional follow-up email:

---

Subject: Request for Overdue Pricing Explanation

Dear [Vendor's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to inquire about the overdue pricing explanation we requested on [specific date or project name]. We have not yet received it and would greatly appreciate your assistance in providing a detailed breakdown of our charges. 

Could you please provide us with an update on when we can expect this information? Your prompt attention to this matter is highly appreciated.

Thank you for your cooperation, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust any details as necessary.
